# v0.3.0 — first publishable release

MCP server that lets any MCP client (VS Code + Copilot Chat, and others) drive
the **Freebuff** coding agent, built on the official `@codebuff/sdk` runtime.

## Highlights

- **Five tools**: `freebuff_run`, `freebuff_status`, `freebuff_stop`,
  `freebuff_delete`, `freebuff_sessions`
- **Safe-by-default agent**: built-in read-only `freebuff-ask` (search, read,
  answer — no writes, no terminal). Full edit/terminal capability is opt-in via
  `agent: 'codebuff/base@0.0.16'`
- **Persisted sessions**: every run is saved to disk and resumable by
  `session_id` across server restarts, with automatic pruning (50 sessions /
  30 days, configurable)
- **Transcript resources**: `freebuff://sessions` (JSON index) and
  `freebuff://sessions/{id}/transcript` (markdown transcript of every
  user/assistant/tool turn)
- **Token-based resume guard**: sessions carry an upper-bound token estimate;
  resumes above the ceiling are refused unless `force_resume` is set
  (thresholds via `FREEBUFF_MCP_RESUME_WARN_TOKENS` /
  `FREEBUFF_MCP_RESUME_MAX_TOKENS`)
- **npx-ready**: `npx -y freebuff-mcp-server` — no clone required
- **CI + publishing**: GitHub Actions runs typecheck/build/protocol-only tests
  on push and PRs (Node 20 + 22); npm publishing is automated from GitHub
  releases with tag/version verification and provenance

## Installation

```bash
npx -y freebuff-mcp-server
```

Or in VS Code, use the included `.vscode/mcp.json` (launches via npx and
prompts for your API key on first use).

## Authentication

Supply a Codebuff API key (https://www.codebuff.com/api-keys — same account as
Freebuff) via `CODEBUFF_API_KEY` / `FREEBUFF_API_KEY`, `--api-key`, or your
existing Freebuff CLI login, which is picked up automatically as a fallback.

> **Known limitation (verified Sept 2026):** the stored CLI session token
> authenticates but SDK runs are billed through the Codebuff API-key path, so
> it currently yields `Payment Required` in normal mode (or `Forbidden` with
> `cost_mode: "free"`). Generate an API key at the link above and the server
> works out of the box.

## Requirements

- Node.js >= 18 (CI covers 20 and 22)
- A Codebuff API key with SDK access for real agent runs
